items.title: Nicki Parrott interviewed by Monk Rowe. Utica, New York, November 6, 2010 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: He became the Paul Shaffer of Australia.

ctx.x: Don Burrows. He’s a string, he’s a legend there, he’s just a great musician, a great guy. He started this jazz course at the Sydney Conservatorium. And I was the first girl student of my bass teacher. It is funny. And he was a great bass player. I don’t know. There’s different ways of — sometimes yeah, sometimes I felt the classes were a waste of time, but I was there with my friends, my sister, and there were five of us from Newcastle that went to the Sydney Con at the same time. We all went to Sydney. Some of…
Well I’m trying to envision you going to one of your many gigs that are, not throw together is not the right word, but it’s not a working band, and someone calls a tune and you don’t know it.
